description_ru: Средне-верхнее звенья. Озерно-аллювиальные отложения четвертой надпойменной террасы. Суглинки, супеси, алевриты, погребенные почвы, пески
note: GGK-200 P-43-XXXI (Karta chetvertichnyh otlozheniy; 72-73E 60d-60d40mN), Quaternary map; edition / print year NOT stated (geokniga holds the map, a typed legend on 5 sheets and a section, no imprint page); RASTER = geokniga FULL SCAN 3706x5079 px (~17 m/px); fills = map tints snap-sampled at labelled units, calibrated on the map (preview_tint_calib.py, two print tints for la4II-III and a3III); cover formations printed only as patterns over the base (fractional indices cover/base): saIII subaerial deposits = red diagonal hatch, vIII eolian sands = red dots, bIV bog peat = T marks -> composites <cover>/<base> (saIII E per PI decision 2026-10-04, vIII E, bIV O; hclass2 = base) from pattern-element regions (work/r200h/prep_fullscan.py: hatch = long straight red lines, ~0.9 km buffer; dots ~0.4 km; T stems ~1.2 km); region boundaries good to ~+-0.5-1 km; lakes print in the unit tints (no WATER row); frame = 4 inner-neatline corners (line centres from profiles) + 9 interior 15x10 min graticule crossings as ties (LOO median 31 m, max 58 m) ; legend units NOT classified (no separable map tint): bIV as a coloured unit: only on sections (on the map only T symbols -> composites bIV/<base>) / vIII-IV (eolian sands, red dots): not told apart from vIII (red dots) -> composites vIII/<base> / aIII-IV, a1III-IV, a2III, aIII (dead valleys), dIV: valley units printed in tints within ~5 dE of a3III / la2III / dIII: read as those (same hclass F, or C for dIV) / m4II-III, laIIkl, mIIkl, laIIsz, lgIItz, laIIsr, lgIIsm, lgIIcr, lIIcr1, laIIcm, aIItb, lIsmk, aItl, mN2-Qsb, pre-Quaternary: narrow valley-side strips / section-only units in teal-green shades not separable from la4II-III / la3III (all lacustrine-alluvial or older; read as the surrounding unit) ; seed = map tint (teal)
